topic: GPT-4 Was Trained on More Text Than You Could Read in 20,000 Years
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

GPT-4 has absorbed more human text than you could ever imagine – or read in many lifetimes!

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 GPT-4 was trained on approximately 13 trillion 'tokens' of text data.
🔹 If a human read 250 words per minute nonstop, it would take over 20,000 years to get through that much text.
🔹 This incredible amount of data allows AI models to understand, generate, and process human language with astonishing accuracy.
